int_name: CECIL B MOORE AVE & GERMANTOWN AVE

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an industrial setting with a continuous but poorly maintained sidewalk on one side and no marked crossings or traffic control devices. The wide, unmarked roadway and lack of pedestrian-scale infrastructure create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Uneven sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is heavily cracked and uneven, posing a trip hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps at the corner makes the sidewalk inaccessible for wheelchair users or those with limited mobility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Add lane markings to define travel lanes and potentially narrow them to reduce vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way street with sidewalks on both sides but no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. The environment is characterized by a mix of industrial and modern residential land uses, with visible pavement degradation and a lack of greenery or safety enhancements.

result.summary: The environment features well-maintained sidewalks and curb ramps but lacks basic crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or traffic control. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the intersection create potential visibility and safety issues for pedestrians.
